result.title: Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents
result.summary: External skills provide language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge, yet how models use such knowledge after it is supplied remains poorly understood. We identify Procedural Exposure Bias (PEB), the tendency of language models to increasingly favor an action as its associated procedural pattern is repeatedly exposed in a skill, even when the interaction state and action relevance remain unchanged. We find that PEB strongly depends on how procedural knowledge is represented: presenting the same content visually substantially attenuates exposure-induced shifts in action preference relative to textual presentation. Further analysis shows that this attenuation primarily arises from visual encoding rather than structured layout. Although repeated procedural signals remain recoverable from Visual representations, they exert a weaker influence on downstream action prediction, distinguishing signal accessibility from its use as action evidence. This effect also extends to executable action selection, where increasing exposure more strongly favors the corresponding action under Text than Visual. Layer-wise analyses show that exposure-dependent action evidence becomes more pronounced toward the model output, with stronger evidence under Text, while activation interventions reveal architecture-specific roles of internal components in transmitting or counteracting the preference shift. Complete-agent evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop further show that Visual skills achieve higher macro-average task success than Text skills for all four evaluated models. These findings establish skill representation as an important factor governing how procedural knowledge is translated into agent decisions. All code is available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Vis-Skill.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「程序性暴露偏差」（PEB）：技能中反复出现的程序模式会让语言模型日益偏好对应动作；作者比较同一内容以视觉与文本形式呈现时的差异，用逐层分析和激活干预考察该偏好向输出传播的方式，并在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上做完整 agent 评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信号可及」与「被用作动作证据」相分离的核心观察，以及视觉/文本表征对比和逐层—激活干预手段，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉内容是否只是保留在内部状态、还是真正参与答案生成，属可借鉴的方法线索。
